description: This file defines the EmployeeWorkShift entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing the association between employees and their work shifts using Doctrine ORM annotations. It includes properties for linking to WorkShift and Employee entities and accessor methods.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkShift
classes.description: Entity class mapping to the ohrm_employee_work_shift table, representing the relationship between an Employee and a WorkShift, with getter and setter methods for its properties.

methods.name: getWorkShift
methods.description: Returns the WorkShift associated with this EmployeeWorkShift.

methods.name: setWorkShift
methods.description: Sets the WorkShift for this EmployeeWorkShift.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this EmployeeWorkShift.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee for this EmployeeWorkShift.
